This result implies that (8.40) imposes no real constraint on the central bank as long as there are no restrictions on, or costs associated with, varying the nominal interest rate. Given the central bank’s optimal choices for the output gap and inflation, (8.40) will simply determine the setting for it necessary to achieve the desired value of xt.
